description: Nine-repetition Frozen read comparison with constexpr Mumbo, Fambo, Dumbo and native hash baselines.
aggregation: Median CPU time of raw repetitions; full iteration also reported per element; CSV uses nine significant digits.
limitations: One Apple M5 Pro host; warm cyclic corpus of fixed 10-byte borrowed string views
Random benchmark order, not shuffled query order
One process per study; no independent Abseil hash-seed samples
Thread affinity and CPU-frequency metadata unavailable on this host
object_bytes excludes heap allocations and borrowed key storage
